title: 입술 벌렸다 모으기
caption: 입술을 양옆으로 벌렸다가 앞으로 모으세요.
motion_prompt: Spread the lips horizontally into a broad relaxed shape, then bring them forward into a rounded kiss pucker, and return to neutral.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: lips stretched broadly sideways with relaxed corners, subtle cheeks lift, slight tooth visibility
gentle rounded kiss pucker with lips projecting forward and corners drawn inward; cheeks follow naturally
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for lip_06_spread_pucker. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Use the attached adult Korean female illustrated therapist as the exact character and style reference. Same face, dark ponytail, white uniform, warm clinic background. Same front-facing head-and-shoulders framing in every tile, mouth and whole jaw clearly visible, same scale and head position, calm gaze. Render each WHOLE face as coherent artwork, including coordinated lip corners, cheeks, jaw, chin and natural linework, texture and shadows. No separately pasted vector mouth. Head/camera stable; jaw moves naturally for lip shapes, remains stable for independent tongue exercises. Tile poses: TILE 1: relaxed neutral closed lips. TILE 2: lips stretched broadly sideways with relaxed corners, subtle cheeks lift, slight tooth visibility. TILE 3: gentle rounded kiss pucker with lips projecting forward and corners drawn inward; cheeks follow naturally. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
